title: Pattern (SC03)
description: Closed field set for the Pattern entity: the only counting carrier the promotion gate reads. Field membership is taken verbatim from .distill/round-2/05-DATA-MODEL.md sec 6 (Pattern row: identity / support_count / distinct_occurrence_count / last_attempted_count / near_duplicate_count / contradiction_count / scope / absorbed_into). Identity layering per sec 5.1 (L0 exact equality holds the only automatic counting and write right; L1 emits hints only; L2 embedding clustering is NOT adopted). Counter admission per sec 5.4: a counter is admissible only with an event -> writer -> consumer -> test chain, so every counter here is an object that must name its writer event, its writer call site, its consumer and at least one test. A bare integer counter is rejected by construction, which is the shape of the times_applied defect that sec 5.4 names as the headline counter-example.

schema_version.$comment: 05 sec 6 closed field set; version pin so a stale writer cannot be read by the new gate.

pattern_id.$comment: Store primary key required by CM-24 content-addressed-idempotent-upsert. 05 sec 6 enumerates business columns only; the id column is plumbing, not policy.

support_count.$comment: 05 sec 5.4: writer = L0 identity equality hit at ingest; consumer = Stage 1 threshold gate; tests = (1) hit -> +1, (2) threshold -> proposal.

distinct_occurrence_count.$comment: 05 sec 5.4: writer = after canonical occurrence folding; consumer = Stage 1 minimum-distinct-source gate (blocks batch same-source promotion). Occurrence-ID provenance itself is DEFERRED (05 sec 7 DM-3) -- this schema demands the anchor, it does not decide which host anchor is used.

last_attempted_count.$comment: 05 sec 6 Pattern row; paired column with support_count so a retry only counts as new evidence (05 sec 5.4 quoting state.rs matches.len() <= last_attempted_count).

near_duplicate_count.$comment: 05 sec 4 M8: deterministic proxy code may write this column. It is NOT contradiction evidence and must never be merged with contradiction_count.

contradiction_count.$comment: 05 sec 4 M8 + sec 5.4: writable only by code after a model judgment, and every write must leave one lifecycle_event row per item; hence the mandatory ledger references.

possible_duplicate.$comment: 05 sec 5.1 L1 and 12 sec M1: similarity produces a hint/marker only, never an automatic merge.

absorbed_into.$comment: 05 sec 6 (merge terminal state) + sec 3: non-empty only on merge/absorb, and the target must already exist -- existence is the resolver's branch, not the schema's.

allOf.$comment: 05 sec 5.1: L1 may not hold automatic counting rights. If the identity layer is L1, no admitted counter may be present on the same record.

layer.$comment: 05 sec 5.1 admits exactly L0 (auto counting + write right) and L1 (hint/proposal only). L2 embedding clustering is NOT adopted, so a record claiming L2 must fail the gate with ENUM_OUT_OF_RANGE (S09 exit 2).

pattern_key.$comment: 05 sec 5.1 'explicit Pattern-Key field': a model may name it, but it exists only after code canonicalizes it (04 row 6 / adjudication C3). The naming is free; the key below is not.

canonical_key.$comment: The NUL-joined canonical field string produced by kd_identity_key (05 sec 5.1). Bookkeeping fields are excluded from it by derivation, and kd_identity_key refuses a single-field strip/trim identity (S05 exit 2).

identity_digest.$comment: sha256(canonical_key) truncated per 05 sec 5.1 ([0:40]). The truncation LENGTH itself is DEFERRED (05 sec 7 DM-1), so the schema pins the hex form and the derivation record states the length actually used.

derivation.$comment: Reproducibility record emitted by kd_identity_key so a reviewer can re-derive the digest without reading the code. DC-SP-1 gate 3 (12 sec 523): the key must contain at least normalized pattern identity + scope + source worker, so the three groups are mandatory here and the gate checks them. 05-DATA-MODEL.md line 122 states TWO axes -- sha256(canonical NUL-join)[0:40] ‖ 显式 Pattern-Key 字段 -- and line 126 makes the Pattern-Key an LLM-named, deterministically validated product of Stage 3 step 12, so a Stage 2 derivation may not require it: `canonical_fields` therefore lists the fields that ACTUALLY joined and the two keys below make a skipped axis visible instead of silent. The final field list stays DEFERRED (05 sec 7 DM-1).

canonical_fields.$comment: minItems 3 = DC-SP-1 gate 3's three mandatory groups. The final field list is DEFERRED (05 sec 7 DM-1); this schema therefore bounds the count and demands the groups, and does not name the semantic fields. PROVISIONAL-CANONICAL-FIELD-SET: the values are the adjudicated minimum (semantic + scope triple, bookkeeping excluded), not a permanent decision.

absent_optional_fields.$comment: Declared canonical fields this record contributed nothing for (absent, or erased by the narrow fold). Recorded so an absent Pattern-Key/worker axis is auditable; an empty array means every declared axis joined.

axes_participating.$comment: Which of gate 3's groups actually moved the digest for this record. A Pattern document must carry all three (12 sec 523); `semantic` + `scope` only is the evidence-layer shape S06 groups on.

normalizer_set.$comment: The adjudicated normalization pipeline of 04 row 6 / 12 sec 725: NFKC, trim, strip .md, lowercase, underscore+space to hyphen, kebab slug, NUL-join, sha256. Versioned so a rule change cannot pass for the same record.

scope_triple.$comment: 05 sec 5.3 S1: typed triple, fail-closed, never defaulted to global.

digest_len.$comment: Declared, not assumed: DM-1 leaves the truncation length open, so the record states what was used.

scope.$comment: 05 sec 5.3: scope = typed triple {workspace, project, layer}; S1 fail-closed non-empty; S3 counter keys must contain scope; S4 the adjudicated object carries scope.. SCOPE VS COHORT (Wave 1 integration): this object is 05-DATA-MODEL.md line 174's typed triple {workspace, project, layer} and nothing else. The identity triple of line 177 invariant 4 is a SEPARATE named object, `cohort` = {workspace, project, path}, whose key set is fixed by the frozen kernel kd_provenance.cohort_key (scripts/kd_provenance.py lines 55-63) and which is defined in schemas/scope-tuple.schema.json ($defs.cohort_triple) and schemas/evidence.schema.json. Support counting groups by `cohort`; promotion filtering branches on `scope.layer` (S10, Wave 3). One key never carries both meanings.

admittedCounter.$comment: 05 sec 5.4 counter admission, encoded structurally: conditions (1) writer event + call site, (2) at least one behavior test, (3) 'never measured' must stay distinguishable from 0. A counter without a named writer cannot be represented, therefore cannot be read by any decision path.

measured.$comment: sec 5.4 (3): default/absent state must not be rendered as real data.

writer_call_site.$comment: sec 5.4 (1): '实现清单里给出文件与符号' -- a file/symbol, not a promise.

consumer.$comment: 05 sec 1 red line 3: every field binds at least one real consuming branch (ordering / write right / promotion / invalidation / report rendering).

tests.$comment: sec 5.4 (2): event -> field change, and field change -> decision change.

judgment_ledger_refs.$comment: Store-side lifecycle_event references for the increments behind `value`. Optional for the deterministic counters, MANDATORY for contradiction_count (see $defs/contradictionCounter), because 05 sec 4 M8 requires '模型判定后由代码回写，且必须逐条留 lifecycle_event'.

05 sec 4 M8: contradiction_count may only be written by code after a model judgment, and 'must leave one lifecycle_event row per item'. These are the store-side ledger references, per sec 2 record_locator (the body holds only a ledger reference, never the authority). A null or empty list is refused, so a proxy count can never be dressed up as contradiction evidence.
